scope: CI-verified main, deployed and verified against the live URL by rendered-DOM assertions (not by the deploy command's exit code).

liveVerification.method: Rendered-DOM assertions against the live URL, plus asset-hash identity with the local build (index-CW4pdzal.js / index-DiWBanHf.css) so a cached or unchanged deploy cannot pass.
verified: cold shared link publishes only l1-island-ready (no phantom l0-atlas-ready) at 1039ms
QFocus question renders unclamped and untruncated
mobile evidence beat states the read-only adjudication boundary
carried question fills the cross-field search once and does not re-latch
login pill height matches the language toggle (44px)
notVerifiableOnProduction: Session-badge rendering and the logout hit target: production has no GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, so /api/me resolves null and the login pill renders instead of the badge. Both were measured behind the local dev-bypass session (badge 44px, logout 44x44) and are guarded by the desktop chrome e2e.
QFT vote/focus ledger writes: the same missing secrets make production read-only, so the write path has no production login to exercise.

deploymentBoundary.reason: 当前 main 已部署: release 4 was built from 39a2d2d after its CI run passed, and the live site serves this build's asset hashes. Any commit after it is this checkpoint's own documentation update, which ships no artifact — if a later commit changes code, this record is stale until re-verified.

bundleBaseline.entryBudgetRationale: Raised 900 → 1024 KiB when wave 3 doubled the curated atlas (176 → 371 islands). The growth is L0 atlas DATA, not a new runtime: atlas.ts is loaded eagerly on purpose so the first frame is a real map with no round trip, and every island's question (`qfocus`) must be present offline because the chart's hover card and the connection-field search both read it from the L0 projection via api/fallback.ts. Deferring qfocus to atlas-detail was measured (it is 36% of the L0 payload, and moving it lands the entry chunk at 914KiB) but rejected: it leaves the no-server readable twin with a questionless island card, which the resilience invariant forbids. Headroom after the raise is 23.6KiB (2.3%), matching the ratio the previous 878/900 baseline ran at.

runtimeBudgetTargets.scope: Local browser diagnostics; not production RUM and not evidence that the current working tree is deployed.

l0AtlasReady.note: Not published on a cold shared link: that route mounts the island directly and never creates the atlas renderer, so the interval is abandoned rather than completed.

l1IslandReady.end: island scene committed plus two animation frames

proofBoundaries: The CI result proves only the recorded committed main baseline.
The production health and counts prove the older deployed release, not current main.
Local browser and build checks for later hardening work must be reported separately from CI and deployment.
